name: Madeleine Beck
text: Working with Sheeba has been a genuinely transformative experience, cementing my belief that true health stems from a balanced, holistic approach rather than temporary fixes. Sheeba is not just a nutritionist; she is a deeply knowledgeable expert in her field. This comprehensive background ensures that her advice is always grounded in science yet personalized for the individual's entire well-being. Sheeba possesses an incredible ability to translate complex scientific principles into valuable, actionable insights that stick with you for life. Her guidance goes far beyond calorie counting or macro-management, delving into the importance of gut health, electrolyte balance, and how nutrition interacts with our mental and emotional states. She emphasizes sustainable lifestyle changes, such as incorporating natural movement, prioritizing hydration and rest, and the power of daily rituals like practicing gratitude. This approach makes adopting healthier habits feel like an integration into life, rather than a demanding chore. Her focus on holistic healthy living is what truly makes her guidance effective. She understands that the body is an interconnected system. For instance, she advocates for addressing underlying issues through targeted nutrition, exemplified by her work on digestive support and the importance of quarterly 'deep dive detoxes' to eliminate both physical and emotional 'toxicity.' Sheeba provides the roadmap and the inspiration needed to achieve lasting well-being. I am immensely grateful for the knowledge she has shared and the sustainable foundation she has helped me build for a healthier, more balanced life.

text: I've been working with Sheeba, my nutritionist, for a while now, and I'm thoroughly impressed! If you're seeking a knowledgeable, compassionate, and non-judgmental nutritionist, I highly recommend Sheeba!
